items.title: Attacker uses an emailed meeting request to pull private drive files out to themselves
Anyone who can email an employee can give the assistant instructions (prompt injection)
Assistant runs with the employee's full inbox, calendar and drive access
Sender and attendee addresses from the email are trusted without verification
Earlier inbox content poisons later decisions
Actions taken without the employee cannot be distinguished from their own
Automated email flood turns into calendar spam and uncapped LLM cost
